findings: F1 (design-adjacent, must gate freeze): The 20s timeout is fixed INCLUDING preflight/setup with zero slack (C7/D1/G60). 506 sequential ro-bind-data mounts + 506 hashes are unmeasured under the real launcher for K/Java; the 0.522s Python probe is explicitly not a bound. If mount/setup wall-time materially erodes compute, the previously-accepted depth5947 run could flip to inconclusive, silently narrowing the sole diagnostic. Require measured setup headroom before freeze.

F2 (core claim unverified): The decisive property—Java resolving user.home to the private empty-classpath HOME—was never exercised (no Java user.home canary ran; forbidden pending admission). Design is internally consistent but its mechanism rests on getpwuid(1000).pw_dir + pinned /etc/passwd + /etc/nsswitch.conf routing to files, not network/socket userdb absent in the netns. Must be proven at live admission.

F3: Read-only cwd /home/charl/Moriarty. krun self-mitigates (cd $tempDir for llvm-krun temps), but any K/kast/kore-print tool writing to cwd fails. Verify no selected tool writes to the RO cwd; confirm TMPDIR/mktemp resolve to the writable private /tmp.

F4: --cap-drop ALL inside the new userns: subsequent strace admission must confirm ptrace of same-uid direct children still works (yama/no-caps) so process/signal capture over the nested PID ns addresses the original K command and descendants.
